level_one.title: Borean Winds
level_one.description: After Frozen Tempest has been active for 2 seconds, Arthas gains 10% Movement Speed.  Passive: Frozen Tempest's Slowing effects last an additional 0.5 seconds and its Mana cost is reduced by 4 per second.

level_four.title: Shattered Armor
level_four.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Howling Blast have their Armor reduced by 15 for 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Icebound Fortitude
level_seven.description: Activate to instantly remove all Roots and Slows. Gain 25 Armor and reduce the duration of Stuns, Slows, and Roots against Arthas by 75% for 3 seconds.  Each Hero Rooted by Howling Blast reduces the cooldown of this ability by 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: Summon Sindragosa
level_ten.description: Deals 230 (+4% per level) damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Deathchill
level_thirteen.description: Howling Blast's damage is increased by 2 for each stack of Frostmourne Hungers.  Howling Blast deals 100% additional damage and Roots for an additional 0.25 seconds against Heroes under 50% Health.

level_sixteen.title: Remorseless Winter
level_sixteen.description: Enemy Heroes that remain within Frozen Tempest for 2.5 seconds are Rooted for 1.25 seconds and heal Arthas for 3% of his maximum Health. This effect has an 8 second cooldown per target.

level_twenty.title: Absolute Zero
level_twenty.description: Sindragosa flies twice as far. Enemy Heroes are Rooted for 2.5 seconds, and then Slowed by 60% for 4 seconds.

level_one.title: Might of the Banshee Queen
level_one.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Withering Fire increases Sylvanas's Attack Speed and Spell Power by 5% for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

level_four.title: Haunting Arrows
level_four.description: Black Arrows can now be activated to cause all Basic Attacks and Abilities to Stun Minions and Structures for 3 seconds. Lasts for 10 seconds. Basic Attacks against Structures reduce this cooldown by 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Festering Wounds
level_seven.description: Increase Haunting Wave's damage by 15%. Haunting Wave applies 3 stacks of Black Arrows.

level_ten.title: Mind Control
level_ten.description: After 0.25 seconds, fire a missile that Mind Controls the first enemy Hero hit. Heroes hit are Silenced, Slowed by 30%, have 3 stacks of Black Arrows applied to them, and are forced to walk towards Sylvanas for 1.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Windrunner
level_thirteen.description: Haunting Wave can be cast a second time for free within 4 seconds after teleporting. Teleporting with Haunting Wave resets the cooldown of Withering Fire.

level_sixteen.title: Will of the Forsaken
level_sixteen.description: Activate to become Unstoppable and gain 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Dark Lady's Call
level_twenty.description: Heroes hit by Mind Control have their vision radius greatly reduced for 5 seconds. Mind Control's cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds.

level_one.title: Pity the Frail
level_one.description: For every Hero hit with Searing Lash, lower the cooldown of Inquisition by 1 seconds. Allies below 30% Health receive 25% more healing from Whitemane.

level_four.title: Martyrdom
level_four.description: Desperate Plea's healing is increased by 30%. Increase this by an additional 10% for each active Zeal.

level_seven.title: Intercession
level_seven.description: Activate to make an ally Unstoppable for 1 second.

level_ten.title: Scarlet Aegis
level_ten.description: Bolster the spirits of nearby allied Heroes, healing them for 300 (+4% per level) and granting them 40 Armor for 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Subjugation
level_thirteen.description: Inquisition reduces all damage the target deals by 50%.

level_sixteen.title: Shared Punishment
level_sixteen.description: Upon casting, Inquisition can chain to an additional enemy Hero near its target, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage every 0.5 seconds. Affected enemies lose 10 Armor.

level_twenty.title: Scarlet Crusade
level_twenty.description: Scarlet Aegis heals for 50% more and makes affected allies Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

level_one.title: Sentinel Wisp
level_one.description: After remaining in a bush for 5 seconds, Wisp's vision radius is increased by 200% and reveals the surrounding area.

level_four.title: Nature's Culling
level_four.description: Increases Nature's Toxin's damage by 125% to non-Heroes.

level_seven.title: Splintered Spear
level_seven.description: Casting Noxious Blossom grants Lunara 3 stacks of Splintered Spear. When Lunara uses her Basic Attack, it hits an additional enemy for each stack of Splintered Spear, consuming 1 stack for each target. Stores up to 3 stacks.  Splintered Spear deals 90 (+4% per level) damage, and applies Nature's Toxin.

level_ten.title: Thornwood Vine
level_ten.description: Send forth vines that deal 184 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in a line.  Stores up to 3 charges.

level_thirteen.title: Abolish Magic
level_thirteen.description: Target an ally to remove all damage over time and disabling effects from them and Lunara. For 2 seconds after, the duration of disabling effects is reduced by 50%.

level_sixteen.title: Unfair Advantage
level_sixteen.description: Nature's Toxin deals 60% more damage to Heroes that are Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned.

level_twenty.title: Intensifying Toxin
level_twenty.description: At 3 stacks, Nature's Toxin deals 40% more damage.

level_one.title: Rocket Boots
level_one.description: Increase the cast range of Xplodium Charge by 30% and its damage by 35%. Hitting an enemy Hero increases Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

level_four.title: Hyperfocus Coils
level_four.description: Heroes hit by Deth Lazor or Xplodium Charge take an additional 2% of their maximum Health in damage. Gazlowe is healed for 150% of the damage dealt.

level_seven.title: Overload
level_seven.description: Deth Lazor can now store up to 2 charges. Each enemy Hero hit by Deth Lazor reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

level_ten.title: Grav-O-Bomb 3000
level_ten.description: After a 1.5 second delay, pull enemies toward the center of an area, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Basic Abilities deal 30% more damage for 5 seconds after casting Grav-O-Bomb 3000.

level_thirteen.title: Overcharged Capacitors
level_thirteen.description: Gazlowe gains 5% Spell Power for each active Rock-It! Turret, up to a maximum of 15%. Dealing Basic Attack damage heals Rock-It! Turrets by 8% of their max health.

level_sixteen.title: Ark Reaktor
level_sixteen.description: Reduce the cooldown of Xplodium Charge by 2 seconds. Casting Xplodium Charge creates 3 miniature Rock-It! Turrets that last for 3 seconds.  These Turrets do not drop Scrap or benefit from other Talents.

level_twenty.title: Bomb Toss
level_twenty.description: Xplodium Charge gains a 2nd charge with a 3 second cooldown between uses and launches 2 more bombs when it detonates.

level_one.title: Colossal Totem
level_one.description: Reactivate Earthbind Totem to move an existing totem to a new location. This can be used once per cast.  Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's area and duration by 50%, and Health by 25%.

level_four.title: Earthliving Enchant
level_four.description: When Chain Heal heals a Hero below 50% Health, they are healed an additional 160 (+4% per level) Health over 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Grounded Totem
level_seven.description: Enemy Heroes in Earthbind Totem's area also have their Attack Speed Slowed by 15% and their Spell Power reduced by 15%.  Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's cast range by 45%.

level_ten.title: Ancestral Healing
level_ten.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 (+4% per level) Health.

level_thirteen.title: Tidal Waves
level_thirteen.description: Reduces Chain Heal's cooldown by 1 second for each Hero healed, and reduces its Mana cost from 60 to 40.

level_sixteen.title: Earthgrasp Totem
level_sixteen.description: When Earthbind Totem is first cast, it deals 90 (+4% per level) damage and Slows nearby enemies by 90% for 1 second.

level_one.title: Consume Vitality
level_one.description: Skeletal Swing's cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit heal Leoric for 4% of his maximum Health.

level_four.title: Kneel, Peasants!
level_four.description: Skeletal Swing deals 75% additional damage to Mercenaries and Monsters, and hitting them activates Skeletal Swing's cost and cooldown refund.

level_seven.title: Hopelessness
level_seven.description: Increase the range of Drain Hope by 25%.

level_ten.title: Entomb
level_ten.description: Create an unpassable tomb for 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Ominous Wraith
level_thirteen.description: Increase Wraith Walk's duration by 100%. Enemy Heroes that come in contact with the wraith deal 50% less damage for 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Royal Focus
level_sixteen.description: Wraith Walk increases the damage of the next Skeletal Swing within 5 seconds by 50%. Each enemy Hero hit by Skeletal Swing reduces the cooldown of Wraith Walk by 7 seconds.

level_one.title: Psi-Infusion
level_one.description: Each non-Structure enemy hit by Psionic Storm restores 0.5 Mana, increased to 5 against Heroes.  Passive: Increase the cast range of Psionic Storm by 33%.

level_four.title: Electric Fence
level_four.description: Force Wall deals 92 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies and Slows them by 35%.

level_seven.title: Psionic Echo
level_seven.description: Casting Psionic Storm causes your next Shock Ray within 3 seconds to only cost 30 Mana and create a Psionic Storm on the first enemy Hero hit.

level_ten.title: Black Hole
level_ten.description: After a 0.5 second cast, create a Black Hole that travels in a long line. Enemy Heroes within the Black Hole's area are quickly pulled towards its center. Touching the center deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Stuns the target for 1.25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Shadow Walk
level_thirteen.description: Tassadar becomes Stealthed and Unrevealable, but cannot attack or use Abilities for 1.5 seconds. While this effect is active, gain 40% increased Movement Speed and 35 Armor.  Can be cast while Channeling Shock Ray.

level_sixteen.title: Executor's Will
level_sixteen.description: Activate to gain full Resonance Beam charge, 20% Spell Power, and cause Basic and Heroic Ability cooldowns to regenerate 25% faster. This effect lasts as long as Resonance Beam remains at full charge.

level_one.title: Frequent Flyer
level_one.description: Activate Frequent Flyer to gain 25% Attack Speed and Tailwind for 4 seconds.  Quest: Minion kills grant 1 stack. Hero Takedowns grant 5 stacks.  Reward: After 60 stacks, gain 20 Attack Damage.  Reward: After 150 stacks, gain 50 additional Attack Damage.  Mythic Reward: After 300 stacks, gain 125 additional Attack Damage.

level_four.title: Hammer Gains
level_four.description: Basic Attacks heal for 20% of the damage dealt to the primary target.

level_seven.title: Secret Weapon
level_seven.description: Increases Hammerang's range by 30% and Basic Attacks deal 75% bonus damage while Hammerang is in flight.

level_ten.title: Mighty Gust
level_ten.description: Push enemies away, and Slow them by 40%, decaying over 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Sustained Winds
level_thirteen.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 1.5% of the Hero's maximum Health, increased to 2% while Tailwind is active.

level_sixteen.title: Afterburner
level_sixteen.description: Barrel Roll increases Movement Speed by 60%, decaying over 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Zealous Glare
level_one.description: Shield Glare gains 1 additional charge, and deals 70% more damage.

level_four.title: Subdue
level_four.description: Hitting 2 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish increases the Slow to 70% and the Slow amount does not decay.  Quest: Hit 4 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish.  Reward: Punish always Slows by 70%.

level_seven.title: Conviction
level_seven.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed, increased to 20% while Condemn is charging up.

level_ten.title: Blessed Shield
level_ten.description: Deal 114 (+4% per level) damage and Stun the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. Blessed Shield then bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 57 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Blessed Hammer
level_thirteen.description: Activate to create 2 hammers that spiral outward from Johanna, dealing 65 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit. Damaging enemies with Basic Abilities reduce the cooldown of this Ability by 2.5 seconds.  Passive: Every 3rd Basic Attack against enemy Heroes releases a hammer.

level_sixteen.title: Holy Renewal
level_sixteen.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Shield Glare reduce its cooldown by 1 second and heals for 5% of Johanna's maximum Health.
